description: A bearded man in a jeweled turban and plumed headdress sits on a raised throne under a gold canopy, in an ornate arched hall with carved stone and lit by windows and wall torches. Turbaned courtiers in robes stand around him, one man bows low on a patterned carpet, attendants carry ornate ewers and trays, and musicians with lutes sit to the right. The costume and architecture read as a South Asian or Persianate court, with no visible text, frame or graphic content.
